meta.notes: History weeks 0-103 under P0 (SIMULATED). lifecycle.flows = consecutive state transitions per serial; counts = each serial's state at the end of history. repair_queue = ROs open at h 17472 (end of history; condemned ROs close without a return and are excluded) plus ROs returned in the last 8 weeks; overdue = open and past the quoted due date; PS2 = RO 1564. tat = completed, non-condemned ROs of real removals (units seeded at t0 excluded): shop TAT = return - shop in; cycle = return - removal. float_examples feed the float calculator: rate_per_30d = network reliability-exposure removal rate, pipeline_days = hub effective pipeline (T_eff), units = serviceable base stock (P0/P1/P2/I125); loop_units = units the engine seeds in the repair loop (palm_vs_sim total_spares - base_stock at AUH), so Palm total spares = units + loop_units. palm_vs_sim = P1 floats on selection seeds 100-119 (Palm analytic vs simulated fill; inventory-policy note section 7), DERIVED.
